Bstream block layouts, control codes, hashes, and validation helpers for vinyl storage.

# Purpose
This header defines the binary stream format used by the vinyl key-value store. It declares the block size, control types, control styles, pair header layout, and the union that maps the on-disk block formats for pairs, sync records, dead records, move records, partition records, and zero padding. It also provides inline helpers for sequence number comparison, control-field encoding and decoding, pair size calculation, and block hashing and validation. The remaining function declarations support full validation of each block type and conversion between control style values and text names.
